manifest.reference_note: 15 nm is a nominal component label, not a Scherrer ground truth. Certified Fourier mean column lengths are different measurands.

performance.scope: warm parser + metadata check + Lorentzian fit; excludes browser/network

checks.name: angular_axis
checks.detail: Expected the notebook's 10501-point plotting grid (5.8438 to 27.0778777 degrees); arbitrary cropping, shifting or interpolation is not approved.

checks.name: wavelength
checks.detail: Measurement 0.041419 nm; published Spinel experiment used 0.071724 nm (0.71724 angstrom). Matching wavelength alone is insufficient.

checks.name: phase_context
checks.detail: Declare the crystalline phases. This checkpoint targets MgAl2O4 in the MgO / alpha-Al2O3 reaction mixture, not arbitrary materials.

checks.name: instrument_identity
checks.detail: Declare the instrument. A laboratory instrument or another beamline is not interchangeable with the fixed BM01 response.

checks.name: geometry
checks.detail: Published specimen was a sapphire capillary at BM01; exact checkpoint-linked detector integration/configuration has not been deposited.

checks.name: training_grid
checks.detail: The exact 2theta training grid is not certified: the released notebook defines its grid for plotting only.

checks.name: instrument_response_and_intensity_envelope
checks.detail: Exact checkpoint-linked instrument U,V,W,X,Y,Z coefficients, integration settings and intensity-scale envelope are unavailable.

checks.name: held_out_accuracy
checks.detail: No held-out dataset with known size labels matched to this Spinel checkpoint is publicly supplied; MAE/RMSE are unavailable.

checks.name: checkpoint_to_publication_identity
checks.detail: The published five-output Spinel network is not the released two-output checkpoint; published accuracy cannot certify this asset.

interpretation: No measured IPF correction; angular calibration does not remove instrumental width.
ZnO has anisotropic size, stacking faults and microstrain; one 002 reflection cannot establish size dominance or an isotropic size.
High R-squared does not establish a pure profile; residuals and profile/window sensitivity remain material.
No accuracy metric against nominal 15 nm or Fourier mean column length: these are not the same measurand.
This public synchrotron dataset is not the user's unspecified Cu scan, and is incompatible with the Spinel CNN.
